Numerals 140 E ('varies', dashed box) + 60 + km 120 E lower case (210), baseline 220 (80 below). Generated at 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 km. Layout: 800 x 300, blue, R100, 16 / 31 (edge 16 + white border 15).
